flags.summary: The party petted the Tser Pool camp dog (svalich_road/tser_camp:dog_pet). One of the five good-dog marks the hidden Good Dogs, All achievement reads.
Someone eased the bear-fur cap off the barn owl on the Tser Pool stage rail (svalich_road/tser_camp:owl_cap).
The party asked the Tser Pool owl, through Speak with Animals, how it likes being a bear (tser_camp:owl_speaks).
Fennimore showed the party the research assistant in his breast pocket (svalich_road/fennimore:pocket).
Fennimore gave the party his annotated copy of his rival's monster guide (svalich_road/fennimore:rival).
Madam Eva remarked, once, on a custom hero named Tav (svalich_road/madam_eva:again).
